gloss: Urashima Tarō's treasure box; box of surprises

definitions.gloss: the treasure box of the Urashima Tarō tale
definitions.explanation: The lacquered box the princess of the sea gives Urashima Tarō, telling him never to open it; when he does, he turns into an old man.
Something full of surprising or delightful things.

notes:
In the tale of ⟦{浦島太郎|うらしまたろう}→浦島太郎：33200_urashimatarou⟧, the princess {乙姫|おとひめ} gives Tarō this box when he leaves the {竜宮城|りゅうぐうじょう} and tells him never to open it. Back home he opens it, smoke pours out, and he becomes an old man.
